const W = window.innerWidth, H = window.innerHeight;
const prints = [];

function randomScatterTransform(tier){
  // DENSITY PASS: tighter spread (was -0.1..1.1x W/H) so artifacts naturally overlap more —
  // a crowded table rather than a gallery wall. Wider rotation range breaks the symmetry.
  const x = 0.02*W + Math.random()*0.96*W;
  const y = 0.0*H + Math.random()*1.0*H;
  const rot = -16 + Math.random()*32;
  let scale = 0.78 + Math.random()*0.37;
  if(tier === 'primary') scale *= 1.22;
  if(tier === 'background') scale *= 0.62; // recedes relative to hero evidence, but stays a visible, substantial object — a dense table, not faint scraps
  return {x, y, rot, scale};
}
function applyTransform(el, t, z){
  el.style.transform = `translate(${t.x}px, ${t.y}px) translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${t.rot}deg) scale(${t.scale})`;
  if(z !== undefined) el.style.zIndex = z;
}
// The archive must already exist when the visitor arrives — not animate into existence. Used
// ONLY for the very first placement below; every subsequent move (pullForward, spotlight,
// fullResettle, etc.) keeps the normal smooth 1.8s transition, completely unchanged.
function applyTransformInstant(el, t, z){
  el.style.transition = 'none';
  applyTransform(el, t, z);
  void el.offsetHeight; // force a reflow so the browser commits this position with no transition
  el.style.transition = '';
}

// REMOVED (per editorial direction): the opacity-based chapter/category reveal that used to
// live here has been deleted entirely. Every artifact now exists — positioned, rotated,
// layered, scaled, and fully visible — from the very first rendered frame. Hero dominance is
// achieved purely through scale and z-order (below), never through hiding or fading anything.

// OPENING SEQUENCE: the first paint should establish international relationships/participation
// as the strongest documentary evidence, with everything else receding as supporting context to
// be discovered afterward. This only shapes the INITIAL placement below — the ongoing shuffle
// (pullForward/slideBack/spotlight/clusterShift/multiPull/fullResettle) is untouched and will mix
// everything together naturally as a visitor keeps watching, exactly as it already did.
// Editorial hierarchy WITHIN the hero tier: not every one of the 17 relationship artifacts
// carries equal historical weight. A DMC World Championship judging credit and a documented
// broadcast appearance are singular, verifiable events — stronger anchors than an undated
// encounter photo. This nudges scale slightly; it does not hide or shrink anything.
const PROMINENCE = {
  qbert_dmc_dubai: 1.11,     // DMC World Championship judging — the single strongest credential in the collection
  shocklee_aforadio: 1.10,   // Verified broadcast appearance, Bomb Squad
  sueside_wutang: 1.05,
  robswift_booth: 1.04,
};
// Evidence-type diversity: with 16 photographs and only a handful of credentials/flyers/jcards,
// the latter can get visually lost. A small legibility boost helps the archive read as varied
// physical evidence (credentials, documents, contact cards) rather than only photographs.
const VARIANT_DIVERSITY_BOOST = { 'v-pass': 1.08, 'v-flyer': 1.05, 'v-jcard': 1.04 };

function openingPlacementTransform(tier, wave, evidenceKey, variant){
  // Real archive piles cluster — they don't distribute evenly across a table. Each wave is
  // anchored to one of a small number of pile centers, with tight jitter around it, so items
  // within a pile overlap heavily and there are genuine gaps between piles. Wave 1 (hero
  // relationship evidence) gets a single dominant central pile; everything else radiates
  // outward in its own smaller clusters.
  const pileCentersByWave = {
    1: [{x:0.42, y:0.41}, {x:0.58, y:0.44}],
    2: [{x:0.30, y:0.62}, {x:0.68, y:0.30}, {x:0.52, y:0.78}, {x:0.16, y:0.36}],
    3: [{x:0.20, y:0.22}, {x:0.80, y:0.60}, {x:0.46, y:0.85}],
    4: [{x:0.14, y:0.48}, {x:0.72, y:0.20}, {x:0.86, y:0.72}],
    5: [{x:0.58, y:0.86}, {x:0.10, y:0.72}, {x:0.90, y:0.42}],
    6: [{x:0.34, y:0.10}, {x:0.86, y:0.30}, {x:0.10, y:0.14}],
    7: [{x:0.20, y:0.90}, {x:0.92, y:0.10}, {x:0.60, y:0.06}, {x:0.02, y:0.55}, {x:0.98, y:0.85}],
  };
  const centers = pileCentersByWave[wave] || pileCentersByWave[7];
  const c = centers[Math.floor(Math.random()*centers.length)];
  // Wave 1 (hero) uses wider horizontal jitter than vertical — fans photos out sideways rather
  // than stacking them in a column, which also exposes more of each photo (and its caption)
  // instead of dead-centering new prints directly on top of the ones beneath them.
  const jitterX = wave === 1 ? 0.27 : 0.17;
  const jitterY = wave === 1 ? 0.17 : 0.17;
  const x = c.x*W + (Math.random()-0.5) * jitterX*2 * W;
  const y = c.y*H + (Math.random()-0.5) * jitterY*2 * H;
  const rot = -18 + Math.random()*36;
  let scale = 1.15 + Math.random()*0.55;
  if(tier === 'primary') scale *= 1.28;
  if(tier === 'background') scale *= 0.65;
  // Hero (wave 1) dominates the first read; supporting waves recede so they're discovered
  // rather than competing for attention. Wave 2 (performance) sits closest to hero prominence
  // among the supporting material — real-world professional evidence, not an afterthought.
  // Waves 3-7 (community, education, workshops, historical, personal) share the remaining
  // attention rather than dominating it, per the editorial rebalance.
  const scaleByWave = { 1:1.25, 2:0.58, 3:0.72, 4:0.70, 5:0.68, 6:0.65, 7:0.60 };
  scale *= (scaleByWave[wave] ?? 1);
  scale *= (PROMINENCE[evidenceKey] ?? 1);
  scale *= (VARIANT_DIVERSITY_BOOST[variant] ?? 1);
  return { x, y, rot, scale };
}
function openingZ(tierZ, wave){
  return tierZ + (7 - wave) * 5; // wave 1 sits on top of the initial stack; later waves recede
}

function buildArtifact(i, entry){
  const variant = entry.variant, tier = entry.tier;
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.className = 'print ' + variant;
  wrap.style.opacity = tier === 'background' ? (0.55 + Math.random()*0.15) : (tier === 'supporting' ? 0.92 : 1);

  const tone = tones[i % tones.length];

  if(variant === 'v-pass'){
    const hole=document.createElement('div'); hole.className='pass-hole'; wrap.appendChild(hole);
    const photo=document.createElement('div'); photo.className='print-photo'; photo.style.setProperty('--tone', tone);
    if(entry.evidence && IMAGES[entry.evidence]){
      photo.style.backgroundImage = `url(data:image/jpeg;base64,${IMAGES[entry.evidence]})`;
      photo.style.backgroundSize = 'cover'; photo.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
    }
    wrap.appendChild(photo);
  } else if(variant === 'v-jcard'){
    const photo=document.createElement('div'); photo.className='print-photo'; photo.style.setProperty('--tone', tone);
    if(entry.evidence && IMAGES[entry.evidence]){
      photo.style.backgroundImage = `url(data:image/jpeg;base64,${IMAGES[entry.evidence]})`;
      photo.style.backgroundSize = 'cover'; photo.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
    }
    wrap.appendChild(photo);
  } else {
    const photo=document.createElement('div'); photo.className='print-photo'; photo.style.setProperty('--tone', tone);
    if(entry.evidence && typeof entry.evidence === 'string' && IMAGES[entry.evidence]){
      photo.style.backgroundImage = `url(data:image/jpeg;base64,${IMAGES[entry.evidence]})`;
      photo.style.backgroundSize = 'cover'; photo.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
    }
    wrap.appendChild(photo);
  }

  // Archival caption: only added to variants that already have genuine white/off-white space
  // to print onto — the Polaroid margin (v-instant), the credential card's own body (v-pass),
  // or the jcard's off-white side panel (v-jcard). Sleeves and flyers have no such surface in
  // their existing design, so nothing is added to them — forcing a caption there would mean
  // extending the object rather than printing onto it.
  const CAPTIONABLE_VARIANTS = ['v-instant', 'v-pass', 'v-jcard'];
  if(entry.caption && CAPTIONABLE_VARIANTS.includes(variant)){
    wrap.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), {
      className: 'archival-caption',
      textContent: entry.caption
    }));
  }

  return wrap;
}

const zPool = [4,7,10,13,16,19,22,25,28,31,34,37,40,44];

roster.forEach((entry, i)=>{
  const print = buildArtifact(i, entry);
  table.appendChild(print);
  const wave = entry.wave || 6;
  const t = openingPlacementTransform(entry.tier, wave, entry.evidence, entry.variant);
  const tierZ = entry.tier === 'primary' ? zPool[8+i%6] : (entry.tier === 'background' ? zPool[i%4] : zPool[4+i%6]);
  const z = openingZ(tierZ, wave);
  applyTransformInstant(print, t, z);
  prints.push({ el: print, t, z, home: {...t} });
  // Every artifact — hero and supporting alike — is fully visible from frame one. Hero
  // dominance is achieved entirely through scale and z-order (openingPlacementTransform,
  // openingZ above), never by hiding or delaying anything.
});

const tapePositions = [[0.22,0.3,-8],[0.63,0.58,5],[0.4,0.72,-4]];
tapePositions.forEach(([xf,yf,rot])=>{
  const tape=document.createElement('div'); tape.className='tape';
  tape.style.left=(xf*W)+'px'; tape.style.top=(yf*H)+'px'; tape.style.transform=`rotate(${rot}deg)`;
  table.appendChild(tape);
});
// Intentionally empty: the placeholder scribbles ("check 1998", "keep") were not grounded in
// any documented evidence, so this layer is left empty rather than replaced with invented content.
const scribbles=[];
scribbles.forEach(s=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='scribble';
  el.style.left=(s.x*W)+'px'; el.style.top=(s.y*H)+'px'; el.style.transform='rotate(-6deg)'; el.textContent=s.text;
  table.appendChild(el);
});

function labelOf(p){ const l=p.el.querySelector('.archival-caption'); return l ? l.textContent : p.el.className.split(' ')[1]; }
function nextZ(){ nextZ.counter=(nextZ.counter||100)+1; return nextZ.counter; }

function pullForward(){
  const p = prints[Math.floor(Math.random()*prints.length)];
  const t = { x: W*0.3+Math.random()*W*0.4, y: H*0.3+Math.random()*H*0.35, rot: -5+Math.random()*10, scale: 1.05+Math.random()*0.25 };
  p.t = t; p.home = {...t};
  applyTransform(p.el, t, nextZ());
  return `pull-forward(${labelOf(p)})`;
}
function slideBack(){
  const p = prints[Math.floor(Math.random()*prints.length)];
  const t = randomScatterTransform();
  t.scale = 0.55 + Math.random()*0.25;
  p.t = t; p.home = {...t};
  const lowZ = zPool[Math.floor(Math.random()*4)];
  applyTransform(p.el, t, lowZ);
  return `slide-back(${labelOf(p)})`;
}
function spotlight(){
  const p = prints[Math.floor(Math.random()*prints.length)];
  const prevT = p.t, prevZ = p.el.style.zIndex;
  // DENSITY PASS: focus point now varies instead of always locking to dead-center — a
  // fixed center point read as too symmetrical/composed for a "living archive" feel.
  const fx = 0.38*W + Math.random()*0.24*W;
  const fy = 0.36*H + Math.random()*0.24*H;
  const focusT = { x: fx, y: fy, rot: -4+Math.random()*8, scale: 1.4 + Math.random()*0.25 };
  applyTransform(p.el, focusT, nextZ());
  setTimeout(()=>{ applyTransform(p.el, prevT, prevZ); }, 2600);
  return `spotlight(${labelOf(p)})`;
}
function multiPull(){
  // DENSITY PASS: new behavior — pulls 2-3 artifacts forward simultaneously instead of one at a
  // time, so the table shows several pieces of evidence commanding attention at once.
  const count = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
  const chosen = prints.sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5).slice(0, count);
  const labels = [];
  chosen.forEach(p=>{
    const t = {
      x: W*0.25 + Math.random()*W*0.5,
      y: H*0.25 + Math.random()*H*0.5,
      rot: -8 + Math.random()*16,
      scale: 1.0 + Math.random()*0.3
    };
    p.t = t; p.home = {...t};
    applyTransform(p.el, t, nextZ());
    labels.push(labelOf(p));
  });
  return `multi-pull(${labels.join(',')})`;
}
function clusterShift(){
  const count = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
  const chosen = prints.sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5).slice(0,count);
  chosen.forEach(p=>{
    const nx = p.t.x + (-40+Math.random()*80);
    const ny = p.t.y + (-30+Math.random()*60);
    // Bug fix: this nudge is relative to current position with no bound — repeated hits on the
    // same artifact (which the opening burst does deliberately) could previously random-walk it
    // off-screen entirely. Clamp to the visible canvas, same margin used elsewhere in the file.
    const t = { x: Math.max(0.02*W, Math.min(0.98*W, nx)), y: Math.max(0, Math.min(H, ny)), rot: p.t.rot + (-6+Math.random()*12), scale: p.t.scale };
    p.t = t; p.home = {...t};
    applyTransform(p.el, t, p.el.style.zIndex);
  });
  return `cluster-shift(${count})`;
}
function fullResettle(){
  prints.forEach((p,i)=>{
    const t = randomScatterTransform();
    p.t = t; p.home = {...t};
    const z = zPool[i];
    applyTransform(p.el, t, z);
  });
  nextZ.counter = 100;
  return 'FULL-RESETTLE';
}

let lastHold = 0;
function nextHold(){
  // ENERGY PASS: faster still — an archival box that's just been opened, not a patient slideshow.
  let hold;
  do {
    const roll = Math.random();
    if(roll < 0.12){ hold = 3400 + Math.random()*1800; }
    else if(roll < 0.35){ hold = 850 + Math.random()*700; }
    else { hold = 1600 + Math.random()*1200; }
  } while (Math.abs(hold - lastHold) < 300);
  lastHold = hold;
  return hold;
}

const behaviorLog = [];
let beatsSinceReconfig = 0;

async function runRhythm(){
  // The archive is already alive the instant it appears: multiple independent movements fire
  // within the same fraction of a second, in different parts of the table, rather than one
  // thing happening, then another, then another.
  // The first second should contain noticeably more activity than the steady-state rhythm
  // below — like a table settling right after being disturbed. Heavily weighted toward
  // clusterShift (small multi-item nudges/rotations) with occasional bigger pulls and brief
  // spotlight reveals mixed in, spread across the whole first ~1050ms rather than stopping
  // after a couple of calls.
  const openingBurst = [
    multiPull, clusterShift, clusterShift, spotlight, clusterShift,
    pullForward, clusterShift, clusterShift, slideBack, clusterShift,
    multiPull, clusterShift, spotlight, clusterShift, pullForward,
    clusterShift, clusterShift
  ];
  const burstDelays = [0,40,90,140,190,240,300,360,420,480,550,620,700,780,860,940,1030];
  openingBurst.forEach((fn, idx) => setTimeout(fn, burstDelays[idx]));

  // Two additional concurrent beat loops run alongside the primary loop below — genuinely
  // overlapping activity in different parts of the table, not a single sequential queue.
  // Neither ever triggers fullResettle; only the primary loop below owns that.
  runSecondaryBeatLoop(700, 1900);
  runSecondaryBeatLoop(1100, 2400);

  while(true){
    const hold = nextHold();
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, hold));
    beatsSinceReconfig++;
    let action;
    // DENSITY PASS: with more artifacts on the table now, full-resettle can wait slightly
    // longer (beats threshold raised) so overlapping clusters have time to actually be seen.
    if(beatsSinceReconfig >= 7 && Math.random() < 0.35 || beatsSinceReconfig >= 10){
      action = fullResettle();
      beatsSinceReconfig = 0;
    } else {
      // ENERGY PASS: further weighted toward simultaneous multi-artifact movement (clusterShift/
      // multiPull) and away from single-artifact holds, so more of the table is in motion at once.
      const roll = Math.random();
      if(roll < 0.16) action = pullForward();
      else if(roll < 0.30) action = slideBack();
      else if(roll < 0.46) action = spotlight();
      else if(roll < 0.74) action = clusterShift();
      else action = multiPull();
    }
    behaviorLog.push(`${Math.round(hold)}ms -> ${action}`);
    if(behaviorLog.length > 8) behaviorLog.shift();
    logEl.textContent = behaviorLog.join(' | ');
  }
}
async function runSecondaryBeatLoop(minMs, maxMs){
  // A second (and third) independently-timed loop, so activity happens concurrently across
  // the table rather than as one shared sequential queue. Uses the same existing actions —
  // no new motion logic, just additional concurrent scheduling.
  while(true){
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, minMs + Math.random()*(maxMs-minMs)));
    const roll = Math.random();
    if(roll < 0.28) pullForward();
    else if(roll < 0.48) slideBack();
    else if(roll < 0.66) spotlight();
    else if(roll < 0.88) clusterShift();
    else multiPull();
  }
}
runRhythm();
